Keys

Arrows move inside a pane; Tab moves between them.

Anywhere

CtrlKOpen the command palette
?Show or hide this sheet
123Jump to feeds, list, article
/Search articles
fFilter the feed list by name
rRefresh feeds
uShow unread only, or everything
EscClose, stop reading aloud, back to the list

In the feed list

↑↓Move between feeds
EnterOpen the feed

In the article list

↑↓Move and open
jkNext and previous article

In the slideshow

sStart the slideshow on this feed
SpacePause, or carry on
←→Previous and next story
vTurn Read to me on or off
EscLeave the slideshow

On an article

wRead full width, or bring the columns back
bFold the feeds away, or bring them back
oOpen the original in a new tab
lLike
dDislike
tSave to read later
UMark unread
CtrlEnterSave the note now (it saves itself anyway)
